scope: Theo web only; native work deferred
semantics: This is an acceptance checklist, not executable tests or a passing test report. Fixture evidence cannot satisfy a live-only case.

cases.title: Web-only build scope
cases.procedure: Inspect the candidate build graph, changed-file list, route mounts and release plan.
cases.required_observations: The web Theo route is replaced; no native executable, GPUI dock migration, native packaging or native-client release gate is introduced.

cases.title: Owner and donor audit
cases.procedure: Trace each extracted ELY/Codex/OpenIDEA component to its data and effect owners; inspect notices and pinned revisions.
cases.required_observations: Each concept has one accepted owner; no duplicate document/terminal/model runtime; extracted files retain appropriate provenance and licenses.

cases.title: Workbench route and orientation
cases.procedure: Open a real project through existing Theo navigation and an existing conversation link.
cases.required_observations: Outer navigation works; files, conversation and tools share the new interior; environment identity is visible; no fabricated resource is created.

cases.title: Resize without clipping
cases.procedure: With measured font/cell metrics resize through 1440x900, 1024x768 and 390x844 CSS-pixel viewports, then increase text size.
cases.required_observations: Visible dock rectangles conserve available space and do not overlap; panels collapse/tab/expand explicitly; text is not shrunk to fit.

cases.title: Dock moves preserve work
cases.procedure: Type drafts in conversation and Markdown; move, split, tab, expand and restore their panels during an active run.
cases.required_observations: Drafts, references, logical selection, undo, run and resource identities survive; only placement changes.

cases.title: Empty tool picker is inert
cases.procedure: Capture domain-operation counters; repeatedly open/filter/close the picker and browse More tools.
cases.required_observations: No process, document, conversation or model request is created; only explicit selected actions produce effects.

cases.title: Registry and shortcut coherence
cases.procedure: Register an allowed test panel, change a shortcut, disable one capability, then inspect picker/palette/semantic actions.
cases.required_observations: All projections use one registry; shortcut labels match active bindings; unavailable controls explain the real reason.

cases.title: File operations and partial search
cases.procedure: Use a workspace with nested paths, excluded files, a symlink, binary file, denied path and paginated search.
cases.required_observations: Correct scoped records open; partial search is identified; unavailable and binary states are truthful; scope escape is refused.

cases.title: Explicit page creation
cases.procedure: Cancel New page, then create one, edit it, move its pane and reopen by document identity.
cases.required_observations: Cancellation leaves no orphan; successful creation produces one real document, retained edits and the same resource identity.

cases.title: Local source input under latency
cases.procedure: Delay HTTP and DB completion deliberately while typing, selecting and moving the caret in a source file.
cases.required_observations: Input and draft preview remain immediate without awaiting replies; no false save claim is shown; queued effects remain bounded.

cases.title: Markdown four-mode continuity
cases.procedure: Open a real Markdown file with headings/lists/table/code; edit and switch Visual, Source, Split and Preview.
cases.required_observations: All views share one session; local text, undo, selection and scroll anchor remain coherent; supported syntax renders meaningfully.

cases.title: Concurrent visual block edit
cases.procedure: Keep a local block edit open; an agent commits a different change, then a conflicting same-block change; commit the local edit.
cases.required_observations: Nonconflicting change reconciles; conflicting text remains recoverable; no branch silently drops the local pending text.

cases.title: Markdown lossless untouched spans
cases.procedure: Visual-edit one paragraph in a fixture containing front matter, comments, raw/unknown syntax, CRLF and fenced code.
cases.required_observations: Only the intended source range changes under the stated normalization contract; unsupported content is retained and source-editable.

cases.title: Unicode coordinate conversion
cases.procedure: Exercise tabs, CJK, combining accents, emoji/ZWJ, surrogate pairs and wrapped lines through typing, selection and semantic navigation.
cases.required_observations: Source ranges and display positions round-trip without split graphemes, invalid slices, wrong edits or cursor drift.

cases.title: Late acknowledgement preserves newer draft
cases.procedure: Submit draft generation 7, type generation 8, then deliver acceptance for generation 7 and an older response out of order.
cases.required_observations: Accepted baseline advances appropriately; generation 8 stays pending; stale responses cannot replace it.

cases.title: Checkpoint and reload
cases.procedure: Obtain a real local checkpoint, reload the web app, and reopen the document before remote sync completes.
cases.required_observations: Checkpointed text and pending metadata recover through the actual owner; UI distinguishes local from remote acceptance.

cases.title: Storage failure is honest
cases.procedure: Deny persistent storage, exhaust configured quota and fail a worker while editing in separate runs.
cases.required_observations: Local draft remains recoverable as far as available memory allows; no durable-save claim; named recovery/export action does not pretend storage succeeded.

cases.title: One DB owner across views/tabs
cases.procedure: Open several panes and browser tabs on the same document/database scope; close the current owner or a view.
cases.required_observations: Access follows the existing ownership/handover protocol; no independent conflicting writable opens or resource leaks.

cases.title: Real Changes groups and history
cases.procedure: In an isolated repository create staged, unstaged, untracked and conflicted files; browse diffs/history/branch operations.
cases.required_observations: Groups and diff content reflect actual repository states; every exposed action invokes a real supported operation.

cases.title: Unsaved editor versus Git index
cases.procedure: Edit an unsaved file, inspect Changes, attempt stage/commit, then explicitly save and repeat.
cases.required_observations: UI makes saved/index versus local draft meaning clear; unsaved text is not silently committed; receipts identify actual content.

cases.title: Concurrent Git operations and commit text
cases.procedure: Begin a commit, change its message draft, modify the diff base, and induce one uncertain mutation result.
cases.required_observations: Newer message survives; stale actions revalidate/refuse; uncertain mutation reconciles before any retry; no duplicate commit.

cases.title: Revision-bound language results
cases.procedure: Request diagnostics/navigation/rename/format, edit the file while requests are pending, then deliver old results.
cases.required_observations: Results carry their source revision; stale results are ignored/refreshed; accepted edit plans use the real document owner.

cases.title: Unavailable IDE provider
cases.procedure: Disable a configured language/build provider while other tools and documents remain open.
cases.required_observations: Named capability is unavailable; no fabricated successful output; unrelated editing and tools remain usable.

cases.title: Theo and external CLI are different bindings
cases.procedure: Keep Theo open, start an explicitly selected Codex or Claude CLI profile in another pane, then send different inputs to each.
cases.required_observations: Each input reaches only its selected target; no hidden thread migration, duplicate model request or transcript fabrication.

cases.title: Composer input/IME/caret
cases.procedure: Compose multiline text with attachments and CJK IME; select/copy/paste; move focus; toggle reduced motion.
cases.required_observations: One insertion per committed input; hollow caret follows real position, is not saved text, stops decorative blink when required; draft and attachments survive.

cases.title: Chat versus shell shortcut routing
cases.procedure: Paste a command into chat, press shell shortcuts without shell focus, then explicitly focus and control the shell.
cases.required_observations: Chat never executes as shell input; browser/workbench shortcuts are not forwarded unintentionally; actual shell input requires the bound controller.

cases.title: Inverse Theo theme behavior
cases.procedure: Capture dark/light/custom terminal appearances while Theo changes activity/expression.
cases.required_observations: One Theo state owner; readable inverse face; no header growth or lost expression state on theme switch.

cases.title: Complete coordinated palette
cases.procedure: Switch Neutral/Paper/Slate/Forest-equivalent profiles across chat, Markdown, changes, cabinet and a terminal test output.
cases.required_observations: Host semantic colors remain coherent/readable; no fixed purple/gold donor palette; ANSI slots adapt and explicit program truecolor follows declared policy.

cases.title: Herdr readiness and explicit profiles
cases.procedure: Test a ready core, unavailable core, older host with missing capability fields, and malformed profile/program.
cases.required_observations: Herdr launches only with positive readiness; failures are named; no silent native shell substitution; environment/argv authority is enforced.

cases.title: Real terminal rendering interoperability
cases.procedure: Run the pinned supported CLI profiles and terminal exercises covering alternate screen, cursor addressing, scrolling, color, Unicode, paste and resize.
cases.required_observations: The mounted Ratzilla pane displays/controls actual interactive screens; parser tests plus real process captures show supported modes; no Markdown-log surrogate.

cases.title: Split stream sequences and reset order
cases.procedure: Split UTF-8/CSI/OSC bytes at every relevant boundary; install a reset while old bytes are delayed.
cases.required_observations: Parser preserves sequences; reset boundary is applied before newer bytes; old/mismatched epoch output cannot repaint the new screen.

cases.title: Herdr detach/refresh identity
cases.procedure: Start a uniquely identified long-running test process, close its pane, refresh, and reopen the saved terminal binding.
cases.required_observations: The same continuing process is observed without a second launch; closing only detached the viewer.

cases.title: Workspace-host restart with surviving core
cases.procedure: Keep the isolated Herdr provider/holder alive while restarting only Theorem workspace host; reconnect browser.
cases.required_observations: Binding epoch/reset behavior is observed; surviving process remains; old stream offsets are not reused against the new host log.

cases.title: Process loss and replacement
cases.procedure: Kill the underlying kept test program unexpectedly, allow documented replacement-shell recovery, then explicitly kill that shell.
cases.required_observations: Lost work and new shell are distinct; original task is not rerun/reported resumed; explicit kill stays final.

cases.title: Observer control and late input
cases.procedure: Attach A as controller and B as observer; attempt input/resize from B, then transfer control while delayed A input is in flight.
cases.required_observations: Observer operations are refused; takeover advances generation; stale A input cannot reach the program.

cases.title: Controller-independent local resizing
cases.procedure: Resize an observer pane and a hidden view repeatedly; then resize the active controller.
cases.required_observations: Only permitted controller changes the program grid; observer-local layout does not steal terminal size ownership.

cases.title: Bounded opening adoption
cases.procedure: While a workspace opens, continuously create scoped terminals from another authorized client, exceeding snapshot size.
cases.required_observations: Opening completes after fixed snapshot boundary; later arrivals continue asynchronously; close/restart is not blocked by an unending queue.

cases.title: Discovery deduplication and missed events
cases.procedure: Deliver repeated created/rebound notices, simulate missed events and reconnect with a reset core sequence.
cases.required_observations: One accepted record per binding; fresh snapshot converges; local launches are not duplicated as adoptions.

cases.title: Scope removal and workspace close race
cases.procedure: Relabel a terminal out of scope, revoke access, and close/reopen the workspace while an adoption reply is delayed.
cases.required_observations: Visibility/input and watches stop in the old scope; no late terminal leaks into another scope; process kill is not implied.

cases.title: Failed Herdr subscription recovery
cases.procedure: Test core unavailable at initial open, subscribe reply timeout, core-closed subscription, and unavailable reattach followed by availability.
cases.required_observations: State names the failure and recoverable next step; supported paths recover without duplicate launch; no permanently silent dead subscription is accepted.

cases.title: Gateway trust and label forgery
cases.procedure: From an unauthorized account attempt raw backend selection, another workspace terminal ID, forged labels, control takeover and environment path injection.
cases.required_observations: Gateway/host refuse access; labels are not permission; credentials/raw core endpoints are absent from browser data.

cases.title: Reported status versus task authority
cases.procedure: Send absent, unknown, blocked and finished program reports and print instructions resembling workbench actions.
cases.required_observations: UI preserves provenance/unknown status; task/approval state changes only through real owner; printed content grants no authority.

cases.title: Elm effect/replay discipline
cases.procedure: Replay fixed messages; instrument rendering; complete old effects after rebinding a pane.
cases.required_observations: View has no I/O; effect intent is explicit; repeated render launches nothing; stale completion cannot overwrite the new binding.

cases.title: Semantic inspection and approval provenance
cases.procedure: Inspect panels and invoke a permitted reveal; attempt a human-only approval from a model-origin message.
cases.required_observations: Stable IDs and allowed actions are inspectable; reveal matches user path; unauthorized approval is refused with preserved actor identity.

cases.title: Account layout restore
cases.procedure: Save editor-centered and minimal layouts, reload, load on another viewport, and restore a layout containing unavailable/unknown panels.
cases.required_observations: Preferences use the real account owner; geometry adapts; missing tools are honest; no process/document is created implicitly; underlying bindings are recoverable.

cases.title: Cabinet real identities and mode override
cases.procedure: Create artifacts through actual sessions, open pixel previews/originals, choose an explicit mode, change theme/layout, and revise source.
cases.required_observations: Companion cabinet identity/revision and preview rules hold; original opens correctly; mode override and selection survive; no new artifact store/model call.

cases.title: Keyboard-only complete workflow
cases.procedure: Without a pointer, choose tools, browse/open/edit a document, navigate changes, move/resize a pane, answer an approval and return focus.
cases.required_observations: All essential actions are reachable; focus is visible and ordered; escape affects the correct transient surface without destroying work.

cases.title: Screen-reader semantics
cases.procedure: Inspect and operate the mounted composer, file tree, picker, tabs, diff controls and terminal controller indicator with a supported screen reader.
cases.required_observations: Meaningful names/roles/state are announced once; editable text is usable; cell rendering and semantic mirror do not duplicate the interface.

cases.title: Browser matrix and responsive web
cases.procedure: Run the critical journey on recorded Chromium, Firefox and WebKit/Safari targets; include 200% zoom and narrow web layout.
cases.required_observations: Document/input/terminal flows work or named support limits block release; no experimental browser flag or native application is required.

cases.title: Account switch and revoked access
cases.procedure: Switch accounts with drafts, cached previews and reconnecting effects; revoke one resource while its preview is visible.
cases.required_observations: Old-scope subscriptions/credentials/visible data are cleared or retained only by explicit secure recovery policy; late effects cannot enter the new account.

cases.title: Unsafe content and readable errors
cases.procedure: Render hostile Markdown/file names/OSC links, a structured error object and unavailable project data.
cases.required_observations: No markup execution, clipboard takeover or fake approval; errors are readable/scoped; unavailable data is not presented as an empty successful collection.

cases.title: Bounded busy-stream responsiveness
cases.procedure: Run multiple configured terminal streams and preview work while typing and using the command picker; exceed retained-output bounds.
cases.required_observations: Configured caps hold; overload invokes supported reset/flow control; input/control remains responsive; no silent dropped-output completion claim.

cases.title: Operation receipts and redaction
cases.procedure: Capture a successful, refused and uncertain document/Git/terminal effect containing synthetic secrets in content.
cases.required_observations: Each outcome correlates to identity/revision/epoch as applicable; diagnostics avoid raw credential/content dumping; uncertain does not become success.

cases.title: Theia parity audit
cases.procedure: Complete the actual baseline parity register for documents, file search, language, SCM/history, runs, terminals and Follow/Add Selection.
cases.required_observations: Every required capability has a reachable replacement and evidence; omissions remain blockers or separately approved deprecations.

cases.title: Cutover and old links
cases.procedure: Inspect delivered bundles/routes and follow old Theo/IDE/resource bookmarks after cutover.
cases.required_observations: No Theia frontend/build/iframe path is needed; appropriate new resource opens or recovery appears; no duplicate session/terminal launch.

cases.title: Rollback preserves work
cases.procedure: Exercise rollback/migration on an isolated account with saved preferences, drafts and a surviving Herdr process.
cases.required_observations: Documents/bindings/preferences remain recoverable; rollback does not kill/recreate processes or drop pending work.

cases.title: Host loss is not migration
cases.procedure: Disconnect or shut down the actual execution environment while a browser/database remains available.
cases.required_observations: UI shows unavailable/lost state truthfully; no claim that a replacement remote process is the same running job.

cases.title: Uncertain launch/input recovery
cases.procedure: Lose a launch reply after acceptance, duplicate an operation within supported dedupe bounds, and delay raw input past ledger retention.
cases.required_observations: Reconciliation finds existing operation when possible; no blind relaunch or late byte replay; uncertainty is shown when no safe proof exists.

cases.title: Registered alternate presentation
cases.procedure: Install/enable an allowed alternate panel renderer through the existing extension mechanism and bind it to a real document.
cases.required_observations: It uses the same owner/actions and scoped permissions; no new eval/runtime/credentials; changing appearance retains resource identity.

cases.title: Full web journey and release evidence
cases.procedure: Run specification section 17 using actual project artifacts, real editing/SCM, Herdr process and account configuration on the matched deployment.
cases.required_observations: All required flows and failures have evidence at one known build combination; no mockups/unit tests are substituted for live claims; native work is not required.

cases.title: Herdr layout extraction isolation
cases.procedure: Extract the pinned Herdr TileLayout boundary; compile in the actual browser target and replay splits, moves, focus, restore and last-pane closure with nonterminal panels.
cases.required_observations: No native/process/Ghostty application dependency enters the browser; stable identities survive restore; geometry is coherent; split/close changes only views and invokes no launch/kill.

cases.title: Protocol identity is not product branding
cases.procedure: Present an older original Herdr/Remux wire fixture to the new client boundary, then connect the pinned supported Core/host pair.
cases.required_observations: Legacy mismatch is explicitly rejected; only the negotiated supported pair carries commands/frames; no accidental binary-format guess or silent fallback.
